_meta.purpose: OPTIONAL overlay that attaches a micro-game to a story scene act WITHOUT editing generated prose — mirrors data/story/branches.json. Each inject names a STORY_SCENES sceneKey + act phase and an `interaction` spec; the scene act gains an interactive beat. Ships EMPTY so no live, game-affecting content activates without maintainer sign-off (each effect is a balance/behaviour change per CLAUDE.md). Phase-3 content rollout fills this per-track so each villain/extra arc gets a signature interaction.
_meta.shape: { sceneKey:'villain.rocket.event3', phase:'climax', interaction:{ gameId:'tell_rocket_grunt', persistKey:'rocket.grunt.read', onWin:{ gold:1500, flag:{key:'rocket.lead.found'} }, onLose:{ gold:0 } } }
_meta.effectSchema: onWin/onLose/onDraw ∈ { gold:int, item:{id,qty}, flag:{key,val}, giftPokemon:'Species'|{species}, skipBattle:true, row:int(defaults to current eventIndex) }. softenBattle is DEPRECATED (no battle-mechanic effects). Dialogue-branch signatures instead live as an act.choice whose options may carry { effect:{...}, requireGold:int, requireItem:{id,qty}, lockedReply:[...] } for ransom/sacrifice/gift routes.
